title: Morgan Stanley's Mike Wilson Says We're Still in a Bull Market
description:
Morgan Stanley Chief US Equity Strategist Mike Wilson says we're still in a bull market, but higher oil prices and interest rates are a risk to stocks. He says investors should continue to own energy stocks as a hedge. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance."
